source.quote: Yulong's own page for the DA-ART Aquila, read 2026-11-25 over plain HTTP, the host having no usable HTTPS. The page title marks it « Discontinued ». Under « Technical Specifications ： »: « ●     DoP64 and DoP128 support over SPDIF/Optical/AES. », « ●     PCM 24bit 384KHz over SPDIF/Optical/AES. », « ●     DoP64, DoP128, Native DSD64/128/256 and PCM 16-32bit, 32-384KHz over USB. » The « 32-384KHz » there is a sample-rate range, read together with « 16-32bit ». The Features list repeats the same three lines in different words. On the converter: « AK4497 DAC with low noise regulator at reference voltage and analogue supply. »; the digital receiver: « Digital process is deployed with a SA8804, which supports DoP64, DoP128,PCM 24bit 384KHz through SPDIF »; USB: « USB input is carefully implemented on XMOS U8 ». Filters: « Highly user customizable digital filter. » and « Working together with 3 filter modes, you might find lots of interesting combinations… ». Three sound modes are described separately: « Mode 1 is balanced; and mode 2 is delicate and firm which might be preferred for classical music; mode 3 is laid back with stronger voice presence… » And: « All of its inputs namely USB, S/PDIF and Toslink all support DSDDoP128 and PCM384K formats. »

facts.chip: « AK4497 DAC », one, with an « SA8804 » S/PDIF receiver and « XMOS U8 » for USB.

device_settings.why: « Working together with 3 filter modes » - a count, no names. The phrase « Highly user customizable digital filter » says nothing more. Three SOUND modes are described separately and in words - balanced, delicate and firm, laid back - and those are deliberate shaping, not reconstruction filters, so they are not recorded as such.

_conditions_NON_CONCLUANTES_chez_Yulong: No terms page found on yulongaudio.com, so no prohibition could be checked - NOT the same as finding none. Measured 2026-11-25: the site has exactly five sections, About Us, Products, News, Support and Contact Us, identical on the English and Chinese trees, and none is legal; no terms, legal, copyright-policy or privacy page is linked from any nav or footer. robots.txt returns 404 with the body « File not found », so no Content-Signal and no Claude group exist because the file does not. Footer on every page: « Copyright (c) 2003-2017 All Rights Reserved Shenzhen Yu Long Yun Electronics Co., Ltd. » - note the end date, nine years stale.
_HTTPS_est_inutilisable_sur_cet_hote: yulongaudio.com, www.yulongaudio.com and daartaudio.com all fail TLS with « no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name », so the site is reachable only over plain HTTP and every URL in this record is http://. yulong-audio.com, en.yulongaudio.com, daart.audio, yulongaudio.cn and da-art.com do not resolve. Second maker today unreachable to any tool that upgrades to HTTPS, after MUSICIAN Audio Technology.
_la_moitie_du_catalogue_nexiste_quen_ima: Yulong's site splits cleanly: the older models carry real specification TEXT in the page body, and every newer model's product detail is nothing but JPEGs - 42 characters of whitespace as the only text. And the Support page offers DRIVERS ONLY, no manuals at all, so for the image-only models there is no text fallback anywhere on the maker's site. The Chinese tree was checked as a fallback and is the same images. Nine models are therefore absent from the base for want of text: Aquila III, Aurora, DA1, DA11, D39, DA2, ASURA, A39 and DP1. No number was read off any image.
_un_rare_cas_ou_le_SPDIF_egale_lUSB: « PCM 24bit 384KHz over SPDIF/Optical/AES » against « PCM 16-32bit, 32-384KHz over USB » - 384 kHz on every socket, with only the bit depth separating them, 24 against 32. On almost every record in this base the S/PDIF sockets stop at a quarter or an eighth of the USB rate; here they match it. The maker says so outright: « All of its inputs namely USB, S/PDIF and Toslink all support DSDDoP128 and PCM384K formats. »
